reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact source and NEAREST 8x detail, complete unchanged current raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; compared pose, cap/frame, note groups and tab, and verified original-task recovery plus evidence/source/output/task/prompt/request/result/sheet bindings with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its upper note row and TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its lower row. External-06 shows four repeated blobs in the upper row and two in the lower row. Restore exactly TWO source-scale separated irregular groups in EACH row, with the original relative lengths and compact footprint. Do not substitute repeated dots or long bars or invent readable writing; retain the blank lower paper and small right-edge tab.

hair_features.reason: Dark brows and a clean-shaven chin remain, with cap-covered hairline and no added glasses or beard.

collar_fit.reason: The red standing collar fits a short broad neck without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The current raw restores the viewer-right pose toward the note, with larger near eye on viewer left and mouth mass toward the note. The cap remains inside the continuous upper frame rail. The olive uniform retains gold-embroidered red collar tabs, dark backplate, blank lower paper and small right-edge tab. White/cyan/alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency and no visible interior hole or lost backing.
entries.alpha_decision: The cap/frame and pose are improved and the exterior shows no visible interior holes. Near-opacity is not itself a rejection ground, but the four-plus-two repeated blobs still do not match the source's two-plus-two separated gray-mark groups, so this remains rejected for the RGB note defect and is not approved for production.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap/collar insignia and note glyph identities are unreadable at 65x67. The rejection is for the clearly visible repeated blob count and grouping, not guessed writing or tiny embroidery.
